build_neb_frames_dissociation: build NEB frames for a dissociation reaction using AutoFrameDissociation with a calculator and relaxed reactant and product systems
build_neb_frames_transfer: build NEB frames for a transfer reaction using AutoFrameTransfer with reactant and product systems and a calculator
build_neb_frames_desorption: build NEB frames for a desorption reaction using AutoFrameDesorption with reactant systems and a desorption height
interpolate_and_correct_frames: interpolate between initial and final ASE atoms frames and correct for atomic overlap along the reaction trajectory
check_adsorbate_adsorbed: check if an adsorbate is adsorbed on a surface slab by testing interstitial distances against covalent radii
